d: Founded in Bahrain in 1930, Al Zain Jewellery is a distinguished jewellery house rooted in Arabian heritage and defined by a longstanding commitment to craftsmanship, creativity, and excellence.

With generations of expertise behind every creation, our Bahrain atelier brings together skilled artisans, technical specialists, and manufacturing professionals who transform precious materials into distinctive jewellery. From contemporary fine jewellery to bespoke High Jewellery and traditional 21K Arabian designs, our work reflects the enduring value of keeping the art of making close to the House.
As we continue to develop our manufacturing capabilities, we welcome talented professionals who share our respect for craftsmanship, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence.

Whether your expertise lies in jewellery production, CAD design, stone setting, finishing, quality control, or manufacturing operations, this is an opportunity to contribute to the creation of exceptional jewellery while developing your craft within an established jewellery house.
We value individuals who take pride in their work, understand the importance of precision, and recognise that exceptional quality is achieved through knowledge, discipline, and collaboration.
q: A strong commitment to quality, precision, and the standards of fine jewellery manufacturing.
Relevant experience in jewellery production, design, stone setting, finishing, quality control, or related manufacturing disciplines.
The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency throughout the production process.
A willingness to share knowledge, develop skills, and contribute to better manufacturing methods.
A collaborative approach and respect for the expertise of colleagues across the atelier.
Reliability, accountability, and pride in delivering work to the required standards.
Specific qualifications and experience will depend on the position.
At the House, craftsmanship is more than a process; it is a heritage carried forward by the people who bring each creation to life.
If you are passionate about jewellery making and would like to contribute your skills to our Bahrain atelier, we invite you to explore our current opportunities and become part of the journey.
Keeping the art of making in-house. Preserving our heritage. Shaping what comes next.

d: The individual should develop and manage stakeholder relationships across Wealth & Retail Banking products, distribution, compliance, risk and operations and ensure comprehensive understanding of business and risk strategy, plans and performance and processes related to Wealth Solution with linkage to Retail banking.

Closely follow latest policy and procedures in Wealth Solution and also related products & processes on retail banking or business banking like client due diligence, anti-money laundering, roll out of Group policies and procedures.
Ensures that the work is performed in accordance with Management standards, Process Guides, the agreed customer service standards, operational risk requirements and regulatory controls.
Ensure all processes are documented, up-to-date and being effectively implemented by the operations team in Dubai and Chennai.
Highlight inherent risk within processes to Management so as to ensure bank risk is kept to the minimum.
Improve current processes using Operational Excellence methodology and tools across all products/functions and drive continuous improvement discipline through standard work.

Work with the WM (Wealth Management)Products team to set targets for Service Level Agreements, Turnaround time, productivity and accuracy measures and ensure robust performance tracking and communication of benefits and results.
Follows rigorously Service Level Agreements established with key internal departments to effectively and efficiently maintain relationships with them.
Provides timely data/information in preparation of reports/returns required by Group, regulators and Tax authorities
All Bancassurance, wealth lending, securities and Mutual Funds applications are timely processed.
Ensure compliance of AML, CDD policies & procedures in accordance with Group and Local Regulatory guidelines.
Support new product launches, special projects together with representatives of the WM Products team.
Ensure that all processes/practices in the Unit comply with the Bank’s risk and compliance procedures to minimize security and risk exposure.
Formulate improvements in operating procedures in order to effectively manage risks and create a robust control environment.
Ensure adherence to all CST (Control Sample Testing), HCL (Health Check List) and ORF (Operational Risk framework).
Assist in coordinating, facilitating and promoting understanding of operational risk and in implementation and management of OR within the Unit.
Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
